🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

8. Energy Trend?

🧭 STRATEGY

IWM (1W: +1.96% | 1M: -2.10%) is in RECOVERY, a countertrend bounce rather than a confirmed reversal.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Stay selective in the NEUTRAL regime: favor energy and defensive exposure, including XLE (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.75%) ABOVE TREND and XLP (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +8.03%) ABOVE TREND. Monitor weakness in XLK (1W: -0.13% | 1M: -5.90%) BELOW TREND; style leadership remains mixed.

BEARISH: If weakness broadens beyond tech, watch XLK (1W: -0.13% | 1M: -5.90%) BELOW TREND for further downside confirmation.

BEARISH: If commodity weakness extends, watch UNG (1W: -10.13% | 1M: -17.06%) and SLV (1W: -5.42% | 1M: -15.45%), both BELOW TREND.
